notes: All figures from Blum technical data sheets (PDF text + drawings read as page images). Where a number was read off a drawing (not a table) it is flagged 'drawing'.
Sources S1/S2/S8/S9 are Blum documents hosted by distributor hpponline.co.uk; S3-S6 are on d2.blum.com; S7 is a US Blum installation sheet on a third-party CDN.
Weight of mechanism / hardware set: NOT given in any datasheet read, so null for all systems.
Envelope L x H x W of each mechanism is not given numerically; only drawn clearances (min internal height/depth/width) are available.
HK-S: standard (non-TIP-ON) EU order codes/LF ranges not retrievable (d2 order spec returned HTML 404; publications.blum.com catalogue pages are image-only). TIP-ON HK-S data from TD-065/5 (2016).
HK-S TIP-ON sheet is internally inconsistent about max cabinet height (400 vs 600).
HK top sheet S3 p7-p8 hole dimension ordering was read from a rendered image; verify horizontal pitch order 37/32/64/32 before drilling.
Side-panel thickness limits are only given for HL top cross stabiliser (15-19 / 20-25 mm); otherwise null.
Mechanism horizontal datum: dimensions in drawings are from front edge of side panel and from top edge; 'H','X','Y' for top systems as labelled in drawing.
Old HL SERVO-DRIVE sheet (S9) is classic HL, not HL top: not used.
